description: Dice Derby is a racing game for 2 to 6 owners that lives in a notebook. Eleven horses, numbered 2 to 12, line up in lanes. Every roll of two dice moves the horse with that number one box closer to the finish.
The 7 horse runs the most but pays the least. The 2 and the 12 are long shots that pay big. Draft your stable before every race, then watch the dice decide it.

steps.title: Draft your stable
steps.text: Owners take turns claiming horses, 2 through 12, and write their initials in each horse's lane.

steps.title: Roll and move
steps.text: Roll two dice. The horse with that total moves: fill in its next box.

steps.title: Cash the winner
steps.text: The first horse to fill its lane wins the race, and its owner scores that horse's payout.

rulesBlurb: Everything you need to play, on one page. The same rules are printed inside the notebook.
